purpose: Recover prior reality into current usable state without silent merge, inference promotion, or loss of return path.

provenance_classes.ASSISTANT_SUMMARY: prior model compression; never outranks source
provenance_classes.UNKNOWN: expected field not recovered; not evidence of absence

anti_merge.law: Similarity is not identity. Temporal adjacency is not causality. Repetition is not confirmation.

reflection_rule.law: REFLECT WHEN USEFUL; PRESERVE THE ORIGINAL.

field_index_map.ADDRESS: schema slot + entity anchor + source ref
field_index_map.RETURN: path to source, conflicting branch, superseded state

operational_homes.field_intake: ingest recovered packets; KEEP BOTH / REPLACE / REJECT
operational_homes.human_port: reflection/confirmation discipline only; no private canon

stop_when: high-value slots grounded, conflicted, or UNKNOWN
unresolved merges held rather than guessed
next bounded action has higher expected value than more retrieval
